experiment: Repeated Top 10 vs Full candidate-pool latency comparison

latency_methodology.retrieval: Hybrid retrieval is executed once per question in each repeat and shared by both configurations.
latency_methodology.reranker: Includes candidate pair construction, CrossEncoder prediction and sorting.
latency_methodology.total: Measured retrieval latency plus reranker latency.
latency_methodology.execution_order: Top 10 and Full execution order alternates across questions and repetitions.
latency_methodology.warmup: CrossEncoder warm-up is excluded from measurements.
